listing.name: 'Splosion Man — 'Splosion Man — Linux & Windows Recompilation (thefixinhixon)
listing.summary: The project describes Linux as fully playable, but crashes can leave shared-memory files and damage the shader cache. CI built a Windows test package that was checked end-to-end through Proton. Native Windows testing has not been reported. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own 'Splosion Man Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the Linux release to import your own ’Splosion Man data. The Windows package is a test build only.

warnings: The project describes Linux as fully playable, but crashes can leave shared-memory files and damage the shader cache. CI built a Windows test package that was checked end-to-end through Proton. Native Windows testing has not been reported.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
